headline: Rain lifts as the hour turns.
body: Nineteen degrees under thinning cloud. West wind runs at thirteen miles. Water remains on the stone while the pressure edges higher.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: cloud thinning, 19°C, W 21 km/h, pressure rising

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: wet paving; residual shine along the kerb
